params.deadline: the last timestamp the launch may run (CL-03).
params.minCoins: the least coins accepted for all of `unbIn`.

MAX_AMOUNT().notice: The largest amount a trade or quote takes: more UNB or coins than any supply can hold.

MAX_TRADE_FEE_BPS().notice: Bounds on the deployment's numbers (`route_coin.trade_fee` 1%, `snipe_start` 50%, `snipe_window` 5 min).

SUPPLY().notice: `route_coin.supply`, in base units: all of it on the curve at launch.

VIRTUAL_UNB().notice: `route_coin.virtual_unb`, in base units. There are no virtual coins.

buy(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,addr.notice: `coin.curve`: buys with `unbIn` UNB for `to`. Pays the trade fee and, within the snipe window, the snipe         tax (burned). All of `unbIn` is taken: a buy always gets fewer coins than the curve holds, so it never         runs out and there is nothing to refund.

coinOf(bytes32).notice: `entryId`'s coin, or zero before it launches.

curveOf(address).notice: The curve's real reserves (`rank.last-out` and `rank.twap-cap` are computed from these and the         virtual reserves) and when it launched.

entryOf(address).notice: The entry a launched coin is for; zero for any other address.

feesOf(address).notice: Trade fees accrued to `recipient` and not yet withdrawn.

lastTradeAt(address).notice: When the coin's price record last moved: the curve's last trade (its launch if none since). Since then the         record has grown at one rate, the curve's price. `CoinFetch` reads it.

launch(bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,a.notice: `coin.launch`, `coin.per-entry`: deploys `entryId`'s coin at `CREATE2(this, salt = entryId)`, mints its         fixed supply to the curve, and makes the first buy of `unbIn` UNB for `to`, free of the snipe tax         (`coin.snipe-tax`). Only the live entry's credited contributor (R2.18) may launch: a bounty never         launches a coin. Reverts unless it buys at least one coin (no coin without a buy).

launchNumberOf(address).notice: `coin`'s place among launches, from 1; zero for any address that is no coin.

launches().notice: How many coins have launched so far; each curve keeps its launch's number.

observe(address).notice: `rank.score`'s time-weighted price: ∫ price dt in seconds from launch to now, each price weighed from         the first trade at a later timestamp, so a price set and undone at one timestamp weighs nothing. A         client's average over [a, b] is `(observe at b − observe at a) / (b − a)`, read at two blocks or rebuilt from         `Bought`/`Sold`. Zero before launch.

predict(bytes32).notice: Where `entryId`'s coin is or will be: its address before and after launch (`coin.per-entry`).

priceOf(address).notice: The coin's price now, UNB per coin scaled by 1e18.

quoteBuy(address,uint256).notice: What `unbIn` UNB buys now: coins out, UNB used (all of `unbIn`), fee and tax. Zero when nothing can be         bought.

quoteSell(address,uint256).notice: What selling `coinsIn` pays now, after the fee (`rank.twap-cap`'s sale value). Zero when it can't sell.

quoteUnbForCoins(address,uint256).notice: The least UNB that buys at least `coinsOut` coins now, fee and tax included; `type(uint256).max` when         the curve can't sell that many (its last coin is never for sale). `coin.bounty-limit` fills against this.

sell(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,add.notice: `coin.curve`, `coin.no-expiry`: sells `coinsIn` coins back to the curve for at least `minUnbOut`, paid         to `to` after the trade fee, never more than the curve's real UNB.

settledPriceOf(address).notice: `coin`'s price as it stood at the end of the block two before this one, which no trade in this block or         the last can move (audit round 2 H-2). Zero for no coin. `CoinFetch` reads it.

snipeTaxBps(address).notice: The snipe tax a buy pays now, in bps (`coin.snipe-tax`).

withdrawFees().notice: Pays the caller the trade fees accrued to it (pull; `coin.curve`'s fee recipient).
